description: rin's parallel constitution sweep expressed as config: a catalogue of producing lenses plus one synthesis lens. The conductor dispatches the gate's producing lenses as read-only sub-agents (decorrelated: reviewer != author, each blind to the others), collates their PASS/VIOLATION findings, then runs the intent-defense meta-referee LAST over the collated PASS claims. The verdict is the synthesis, never a single generalist reviewer. Every gate listed in roster_dispatch_gates dispatches exactly its roster from review-rosters.json, which is also the floor the scribe enforces. The catalogue is the set of lenses a roster may draw from.
model_source: Each lens runs on the model its projected agent definition declares. Dispatch without a model override so the agent tier remains the source of its harness-specific model projection.

synthesis_lens.input: the collated PASS claims from every producing lens
synthesis_lens.role: re-test each PASS against the intent of the cited rule, not its letter; the decorrelation guarantee no script can catch

floor_not_ceiling: The producing lenses a gate dispatches, plus the intent-defense synthesis, are the floor. For unusual surface area (an auth spec, a schema migration), dispatch extra ad-hoc read-only lens sub-agents alongside the board and fold their findings into the synthesis.
verdict_contract: READY only when every dispatched producing lens is READY (or its VIOLATIONs resolved at a principled bar) AND every PASS survives the intent-defense re-test. Any surviving VIOLATION or letter-vs-intent gap is NOT-READY with cited findings routed back to the builder for up to reviewer_max_iterations. A finding still unresolved at the iteration limit is written into the stage's review diagnosis (review-diagnosis.md in the stage's record directory), one entry per finding naming its class: one of the reserved classes (a constitution or rules-layer amendment, a recut of ratified scope, weakening a standing guard, a values call the rules do not cover, or money and external identity), or problem; a finding in a reserved class parks the record, naming the class, and any other finding is a problem the lane fixes before it convenes again. Once the iterations are spent, the lane convenes again only through the gate's rejection-and-revision path (stage-protocol-reviewer.md), which restarts the review budget; each restart is recorded in the review diagnosis, and nothing yet caps how many there are.
